create_osmesa_context: create an OSMesaContext instance to initialize an off-screen OpenGL rendering context backed by OSMesa
init_osmesa_platform: call _platform_init on OSMesaContext with max_width and max_height to create the OSMesa GL context and render buffer
make_osmesa_current: call _platform_make_current on OSMesaContext to set the OSMesa context as the active OpenGL context
free_osmesa_context: call _platform_free on OSMesaContext to destroy the OSMesa context and free the render buffer
review_osmesa_context_class: review the OSMesaContext class and its platform-specific init, make_current, and free methods for off-screen rendering
